items.statement: The submission defines and retains distinct UC-1, UC-2 and UC-3 56-atom model identities, including the stated substitution progression.
items.expected: Three identifiable states are present: undoped, one-Li/one-F, and the latter plus one-Si, with candidate identity and composition retained.

items.statement: Advanced structures are reported only after documented periodic relaxation/convergence and reproducible local-geometry extraction.
items.expected: Each reported candidate has convergence evidence and named bond/angle extraction context.

items.statement: The UC-1 local geometry includes Zn-O 1.98 A, O-Zn-O 109.47 degrees, Al-O 1.91 A and O-Al-O 97.22 degrees.
items.expected: Those four values are reported for the UC-1 local environments.

items.statement: The UC-2 local geometry includes Li-O 1.93 A, O-Li-O 113.93 degrees, Al-F 2.09 A and O-Al-F 92.83 degrees.
items.expected: Those four values are reported for UC-2.

items.statement: The UC-3 local geometry includes Si-O 1.86 A, O-Si-O 114.14 degrees, Li-O 1.94 A, O-Li-O 114.18 degrees, Al-F 2.15 A and O-Al-F 89.52 degrees.
items.expected: Those six values are reported for UC-3.
